mcscratch.place: Use or place item in inventory slot [SLOT] at [DIRECTION]
mcscratch.drop: Drop [QUANTITY] item(s) in inventory slot [SLOT] to [DIRECTION]
mcscratch.dropAll: Drop all item in inventory to [DIRECTION]
mcscratch.getItemDetail: Get item detail in the inventory slot [SLOT]
mcscratch.getItemSpace: Get item space in the inventory slot [SLOT]
mcscratch.getItemCount: Get number of item in the inventory slot [SLOT]
mcscratch.transferTo: Transfer item from inventory slot [SOURCE] to [DEST] quantity [QUANTITY]
mcscratch.clone: Clone blocks from [FROM_TYPE] position [FROM_X] [FROM_Y] [FROM_Z] to [TO_TYPE] position [TO_X] [TO_Y] [TO_Z] to [DEST_TYPE] position [DEST_X] [DEST_Y] [DEST_Z]
mcscratch.executeAsOther: Execute command [COMMAND] on behalf of [ORIGIN] at [POS_TYPE] position [X] [Y] [Z]
mcscratch.fill: Fill from [FROM_TYPE] position [FROM_X] [FROM_Y] [FROM_Z] to [TO_TYPE] position [TO_X] [TO_Y] [TO_Z] with [TILE] using tile data [DATA]
mcscratch.setBlock: Set block at [POS_TYPE] position [X] [Y] [Z] to block type [TILE] using tile data [DATA]
mcscratch.testForBlock: Tests whether a block type [TILE] is in a [POS_TYPE] position [X] [Y] [Z]
mcscratch.testForBlocks: Tests whether the pattern between [BEGIN_TYPE] position [BEGIN_X] [BEGIN_Y] [BEGIN_Z] to [END_TYPE] position [END_X] [END_Y] [END_Z] is matched at [DEST_TYPE] position [DEST_X] [DEST_Y] [DEST_Z]
